constitutional_basis: Article XXX (never optimize the evaluator), Article VIII (certification must attack itself)
purpose: Prevent another P-05 tautology and another P-19 misleading metric. The machine must establish metric validity BEFORE using a metric in an acceptance decision.

1_physical_meaning.requirement: The metric must have a clear physical meaning tied to the candidate's mechanism.
1_physical_meaning.failure_mode: P-19 'drainage_capacity_pct' — preserves flow by allowing dangerous ICP. Physical meaning was drainage volume, but the actual engineering objective was safety.
1_physical_meaning.test: State the physical quantity being measured. State why this quantity matters for the candidate's purpose.

2_clinical_engineering_relevance.requirement: The metric must measure something the buyer/end-user actually cares about.
2_clinical_engineering_relevance.failure_mode: P-05 'wash-out gate coincidence' — measured tautological coincidence, not therapeutic effect.
2_clinical_engineering_relevance.test: Connect the metric to a clinical endpoint (for medical) or engineering spec (for non-medical). Cite the source (AANS guidelines, FDA guidance, engineering standard).

3_comparator_sensitivity.requirement: The metric must distinguish the candidate from the comparator.
3_comparator_sensitivity.failure_mode: P-03 'drainage in-bounds' — both with-floor and without-floor produce 100% in-bounds. Metric does not distinguish.
3_comparator_sensitivity.test: Identify the comparator. Show that the metric produces different values for candidate vs comparator under the same conditions.

4_failure_sensitivity.requirement: The metric must capture the actual failure mode, not a proxy.
4_failure_sensitivity.failure_mode: P-19 'drainage_capacity' — system 'passes' by allowing ICP to reach dangerous levels. Metric captures drainage, not safety failure.
4_failure_sensitivity.test: Identify the actual failure mode. Show that the metric goes bad when the failure mode occurs.

gate_enforcement.before_metric_use: All 4 requirements must be documented in the preregistration BEFORE any execution.
gate_enforcement.adversarial_test: Construct a scenario where the candidate 'passes' the metric but the underlying system is wrong (Article XXX). If the adversarial test passes the metric, the metric is INVALID.
gate_enforcement.blocking: A metric that fails METRIC_VALIDITY cannot be used in the falsification criterion. The candidate cannot progress until a valid metric is defined.

P-01.physical_meaning: Maximum intracranial pressure during worst-case obstruction scenario
P-01.comparator_sensitivity: Multi-segment produces lower peak than single-segment (validated R313)
P-01.failure_sensitivity: Peak ICP rises when drainage fails — captures actual failure mode

P-19_R313.clinical_relevance: INDIRECT — drainage volume does not directly map to patient safety
P-19_R313.failure_sensitivity: FAIL — system preserves drainage by allowing dangerous ICP. Metric does not capture safety failure.

P-19_R314.physical_meaning: Time until intracranial pressure crosses safety threshold
P-19_R314.clinical_relevance: Direct clinical endpoint (AANS Brain Trauma Foundation: ICP > 22 mmHg requires treatment)
P-19_R314.failure_sensitivity: Captures actual failure mode (dangerous ICP, not low flow)

P-15.physical_meaning: Percentage of time sensing functions at typical cardiac harvest
P-15.clinical_relevance: INDIRECT — uptime doesn't directly map to clinical outcome, but is necessary for monitoring
P-15.failure_sensitivity: Uptime drops when harvest < load — captures power failure mode

integration_with_Article_XXX.article_XXX_test: Before accepting a metric, ask: 'What would make this metric PASS while the underlying system is wrong?'
integration_with_Article_XXX.P-19_R313_example: A controller that opens all drainage paths at maximum conductance would PASS drainage_capacity_pct while allowing ICP to spike. This is the exact failure mode the metric missed.
integration_with_Article_XXX.gate_addition: METRIC_VALIDITY is now a mandatory preregistration field for all candidates. No metric, no execution.
